actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared the original and complete unchanged raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan composites. Receding gray-dark parted hair and brows, round thin spectacles visible behind the original gray vertical prison bars, left-facing three-quarter pose and dark olive high tunic with pale inner edge are retained, together with the original top/bottom rails. No invented moustache or tie. Compact round mascot head and short broad neck fit the widened original collar without clipping, long pillar neck or white belly at neckline. The dark frame, shaded internal backing and aged lower-right paper are retained; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole-image alpha extrema are [0, 255]. Finite interior sampling is numerical support only, not a claim of globally255 interiors. Composites show no material internal holes. Release eligibility remains subject to the current independent exclusion audit. Art approval only; native derivatives and live-game acceptance are separate.
